sources.title: Basic eligibility requirements
sources.summary: StudentAid BC assesses immigration status, program residency, study eligibility and financial need. A basic screen cannot determine an award.

sources.title: BC NSP eligibility and provider directory
sources.summary: BC NSP covers specified newcomer categories. For international post-secondary students, access depends on whether their institution provides the relevant service.
sources.evidence_section: Eligibility list; Find a service provider

sources.title: Find free newcomer services near you
sources.summary: IRCC settlement services depend on status and specific pathways. Some temporary residents have exceptions that require individual confirmation.

sources.title: Economic-class PR eligibility periods
sources.summary: Economic-class permanent residents face time limits. Transition wording and examples require careful review; VERA does not calculate an end date.

sources.title: Federal Benefits Finder
